items.headline: Cyber Resilience Act: 24-hour reporting for exploited vulnerabilities is now live (sample)
items.body: Manufacturers placing products on the EU market must report actively exploited vulnerabilities within 24 hours. SBOM generation moves from best practice to a procurement precondition in scope sectors.

evidence.quote: Manufacturers must report actively exploited vulnerabilities within 24 hours of awareness.

items.headline: NIS2 enforcement guidance clarifies software supply chain obligations for essential entities (sample)
items.body: New guidance ties supply-chain risk management to concrete evidence requirements. Organisations in essential sectors will need demonstrable provenance and vulnerability handling across their software dependencies.

evidence.quote: Entities must manage supply-chain risks with demonstrable provenance and vulnerability handling.

items.headline: SLSA v1.1 build-provenance adoption crosses majority default-on across CI providers (sample)
items.body: Provenance generation is becoming a default rather than an opt-in across major build platforms. The centre of gravity for supply-chain integrity is shifting from scanning after the fact to attesting at build time.

evidence.quote: Build platforms report majority default-on generation of SLSA provenance.

items.headline: OpenSSF publishes updated baseline for open-source project security posture (sample)
items.body: A refreshed security baseline raises expectations for signing, provenance and vulnerability disclosure across widely used open-source projects — nudging the entire ecosystem toward attestable artifacts.

evidence.quote: The baseline raises expectations for signing, provenance and vulnerability disclosure.

items.headline: Malicious-package campaign targets popular npm and PyPI namespaces via typosquatting (sample)
items.body: A coordinated campaign uploaded lookalike packages to public registries, with install-time payloads. Reinforces the case for curation and malware scanning at the proxy boundary rather than at deploy time.

evidence.quote: Lookalike packages with install-time payloads were uploaded to public registries.

items.headline: A supply-chain security project reaches CNCF graduation (sample)
items.body: Graduation signals production maturity and broad adoption for a project in the artifact-signing space. Ecosystem consolidation around a small number of graduated tools shapes what buyers expect as standard.

evidence.quote: The project has reached graduated maturity level within CNCF.
